interpretations: Patients with at least one single lab record where `U-PRO` = '-' and `RA` = '-'; the average `ALP` and `HCT` are computed over all of that patient's lab records.
Patients with at least one single lab record where `U-PRO` = '-' and `RA` = '-'; the average `ALP` and `HCT` are computed only over those records where both are '-'.
Patients who have at least one lab record with `U-PRO` = '-' and at least one lab record (possibly a different date) with `RA` = '-'; the averages are computed over all of the patient's lab records.

Patients who have at least one lab record with `U-PRO` = '-' and at least one lab record (possibly a different date) with `RA` = '-'; the averages are computed only over the records where `U-PRO` = '-' or `RA` = '-'.
Patients whose every lab record has `U-PRO` = '-' and `RA` = '-'; the averages are computed over all of their records.
Patients whose latest lab record has `U-PRO` = '-' and `RA` = '-'; the averages are computed over all of their lab records.

'-' matches only the exact string '-', so values such as '+-' are excluded.
'-' also covers negative-like values such as '+-' or an empty value.
Only patients with a row in the Patient table are included (inner join), and `SEX` comes from that table.
The sort puts `HCT` averages from highest to lowest, with patients whose average `HCT` is NULL placed last.
`LIMIT 10` returns exactly 10 rows, with ties at the cutoff broken arbitrarily.
All patients tied with the 10th-ranked `HCT` average are included, so more than 10 rows may be returned.
The averages ignore NULLs, and zero values count as real measurements.

queries: SELECT ID, AVG(ALP), AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY ID

SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-')

SELECT ID
FROM Laboratory
GROUP BY ID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

SELECT ID
FROM Laboratory
GROUP BY ID
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0;

SELECT L.ID
FROM Laboratory L
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID)
  AND L.`U-PRO` = '-'
  AND L.RA = '-'
GROUP BY L.ID;
